passage.text: Next Friday is our last class, so I'd like to invite you all to dinner.
passage.reading: ˈnɛkst ˈfraɪdeɪ ɪz aʊr ˈlæst ˈklæs, soʊ aɪd ˈlaɪk tu ɪnˈvaɪt juː ˈɔːl tə ˈdɪnər.

passage.text: We're having dinner at a Thai restaurant near the university at seven o'clock.
passage.reading: wɪr ˈhævɪŋ ˈdɪnər ət ə ˈtaɪ ˈrɛstərɑːnt ˈnɪr ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ət ˈsɛvən əˈklɑːk.

passage.text: Dinner is free, but please bring one photo from this semester.
passage.reading: ˈdɪnər ɪz ˈfriː, bʌt ˈpliːz ˈbrɪŋ ˈwʌn ˈfoʊtoʊ frəm ðɪs səˈmɛstər.

passage.text: We can look at the photos together and talk about our favorite classes.
passage.reading: wiː kən ˈlʊk ət ðə ˈfoʊtoʊz təˈɡɛðər ənd ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt aʊr ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈklæsɪz.

passage.text: There's no dress code, so wear comfortable clothes.
passage.reading: ðɛrz ˈnoʊ ˈdrɛs ˌkoʊd, soʊ ˈwɛr ˈkʌmftərbəl ˈkloʊðz.

passage.text: Please let me know before Wednesday.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˌlɛt mi ˈnoʊ bɪˈfɔːr ˈwɛnzdeɪ.
